column1: # The 16 aisles: id (used by the app, src/model/aisles.js and src/app/i18n.js), Spanish and English names,
# the aisle's default emoji (Unicode emoji version ≤ 13.0, present in sources/cldr49-emoji-es-MX.tsv) and the
# default walking order (produce first, frozen last; a starting point, not a fact about any store: every list keeps its own).
# Tortillería and salchichonería are separate because PROFECO's categories and INEGI's codes keep them apart and
# Mexican supermarkets have both counters (docs/research/2026-10-21-vocab.md §0). Human file; emoji chosen by Claude (AI)
